story: As a Finance analyst, I want to review consolidated bank and ledger records so I can identify balances needing attention
As a Operations analyst, I want to auto-clear matching transactions so I can focus on genuine exceptions
As a Operations analyst, I want to flag amount mismatches so I can investigate unreconciled amounts
As a Operations analyst, I want to detect duplicate payment entries so I can prevent duplicate clearance
As a Finance analyst, I want to flag blank payment references so I can request supporting evidence
As a Finance analyst, I want to prioritize records older than seven days so I can reduce aged exceptions
As a Operations lead, I want to view exceptions by category so I can allocate review workload
As a Finance lead, I want to review productivity assumptions so I can assess the proposed workflow
As a Business analyst, I want to trace each control to an acceptance test so I can validate completeness
As a Tester, I want to replay known exception scenarios so I can verify routing rules
As a Project manager, I want to view a documented decision log so I can track approval and dependencies
As a Business stakeholder, I want to review an audit-ready export so I can confirm proposed process readiness
